population: The peso_lab-weighted complete-case adult distribution in the PNS 2013 laboratory-substudy release, not asserted to be nationally representative: baseline age 20–79, recorded sex 1/2, dictionary-admissible weight/height and final interview SBP/DBP, positive finite laboratory weight. Exclude reported baseline pregnancy; unknown/inapplicable pregnancy retained. No HbA1c, treatment or hypertension restriction. Generated equal-weight rows represent this defined analytical distribution under explicit transport assumptions. Baseline BP timing and unknown released final-reading aggregation must be retained as measurement limitations.

measurement.description: Same named variables and units; unverified source-device/averaging transport, no measurement correction. Strict unsupported source statistics stay unavailable.
